game.title: Pelicans Riding Bicycles: A Feasibility Study
game.subtitle: The Field Trials
game.thesis: Because if a fish can fit in that pouch, a pedal stroke is frankly beneath us.
about.heading: About the Study
about.body: One pelican. One bicycle. Five field trials. Every asset in this game was produced by the catcave factory's own planes — the sprite and tiles by pixd, the tune by sond, this very title screen in the design plane's deck language, the strings localized through itotori, and the concept art rendered by blendd.
about.provenance: Full provenance ledger: manifest/manifest.json in cat-cave/pelican-game.
hint.controls: Pedal: → / D · Lean: ← → in air · Brake: ↓ / S · Restart: R
hint.touch: Left side: lean & brake · Right side: pedal
intro.objective: Reach the flag. Flips score. The beak must stay up.
msg.crashed.body: The pelican has dismounted. Press R to re-mount.
msg.allclear.body: Five trials, one pelican, zero regrets. The Institute recommends funding the pilot program immediately.
